Originally from the San Fernando Valley in California, I moved to the East Coast to study statistics and economics at Swarthmore College, where I also played on the varsity tennis team. I’m now a biostatistics graduate student at Johns Hopkins, where I’m particularly interested in clinical trial methodology and causal inference in public health.
